messages:
violet_marketing: Quick kickoff for the Pricing Calc playbook test. Goal: validate lead intent signals from the calc and tweak mid-tier names. Need copy for FAQ micro-snippets, two distinct mid-tier labels to A/B, and webhook fields for 'Request proposal' flows. Drafts: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/playbook (comments open).

omar_growth: Mid-tier name suggestions: 'Velocity' vs 'Momentum'. They feel different tone-wise; Velocity = performance, Momentum = growth. Primary metric = % who pick Request proposal after seeing estimate.

kira_cx: Localization: show VAT when region=EU and include a short parenthetical "(+ VAT where applicable)" next to price. Also surface a tooltip: "How we estimate costs" linking to /help/pricing-estimates-local.

ben_sales: Routing: if user clicks 'Request proposal' send payload to /webhooks/proposals containing keys: `email`, `estimate_usd`, `request_type`, `wants_demo` and `region`. Example: `{\"email\":\"user@org.com\",\"estimate_usd\":7300,\"request_type\":\"proposal\",\"wants_demo\":true,\"region\":\"EMEA\"}`. Mark `high_priority=true` when estimate_usd >= 8000.

ali_prod: We'll emit `wants_demo` (bool), `estimate_usd` (number), `region` (string), `experiment_variant` (string). Feature flag = `pricing_calc_playbook`. ETA webhook mapped by Thurs.

violet_marketing: For FAQ microcopy: draft Q/A - "Will this be my invoice amount?" -> "The calculator gives an estimate to help planning. Your billed amount depends on committed terms, discounts, and taxes. Pick 'Request proposal' for a validated quote." Change wording suggestions welcome.

omar_growth: Love that. Small copy tweak: replace "billed amount" with "final billing"? keeps tone clear. Also add UTM tag `utm_term=calc_playbook` on the CTA.

kira_cx: For the two sample use-case examples in the FAQ, use 'Support assistant' and 'Knowledge search' with ballpark costs per 1k tokens, written as ranges (e.g., "$0.20 - $0.60 per 1k tokens") so folks can orient. Avoid exact performance claims.

ben_sales: Add a checkbox "I want a sales proposal" on the calc result card; map to `wants_demo` true. Also ask product to include `lead_score_hint` computed client-side (low/med/high) so we can triage.

ali_prod: We can add `lead_score_hint` string, computed by the form. We'll document mapping. Also plan rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% after quality review.

violet_marketing: Webinar tie-in: attendees who use the calc get a follow-up slide in the post-webinar deck showing an example estimate and a short benchmark line: "Internal tests show favorable cost-to-throughput tradeoffs on common request shapes." Keep numbers out until confirmed.

omar_growth: A/B plan: Variant A = Velocity, Variant B = Momentum. Track conversion funnel: calc starts -> proposal clicks -> demo bookings -> SQLs. I'll publish the tracking sheet.

kira_cx: EU-specific email copy must mention VAT and include localized support links. I'll prepare snippets for FR/DE/ES.

ben_sales: When `estimate_usd` >= 12000 set `enterprise_interest=true` and auto-assign to Enterprise queue. Also create SF opportunity stub with source=pricing_calc_playbook.

ali_prod: We'll implement `enterprise_interest` flag and SF fanout. Need sales ops to confirm SF field names.

release-bot: Reminder: marketing checklist for calc-playbook due 2025-09-20 16:00 UTC. Link: https://release.redwood.ai/checklists/calc-playbook

violet_marketing: Great. Actions: Ali to confirm webhook mapping Thurs, Omar to publish A/B tracking plan by EOD Fri, Kira to draft localized FAQ snippets, Ben to confirm SF field names. Ping here if anything blocks.
